On-demand Stripe receipt details for a checkout payment on this
billing payment (receipt_url plus fields to render it in-app).

GET /apis/v2/billing/payments/{id}/stripe-receipt[?payment_id=<uuid>]

``payment_id`` selects a specific CheckoutPayment (as listed in the
detail response's ``payments``); defaults to the latest completed one.
Nothing is stored locally — details come from Stripe per request.
